probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A combination product comprising: (A) BH4, a __defined__ functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a __specific__ pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor; and (B) an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII, or a __defined__ pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, wherein each of components (A) and (B) is formulated in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

2. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a __defined__ functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a __specific__ pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor, an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII, or a __defined__ pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, and a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

3. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a kit of parts comprising components: (I) a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a __defined__ functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a __specific__ pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier; and (II) a pharmaceutical formulation including an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII, or a __defined__ pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier, which components (I) and (II) are each provided in a form that is suitable for administration in conjunction with the other.

6. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in any one of the preceding claims, wherein the component that is BH4 or a __defined__ functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof is a compound of formula I, O R HN R2 N R3 R -N N N R4 H R5 R wherein R1 and R2 either independently represent H or C12 alkyl, or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached; R3 represents aryl or C1.4 alkyl, which alkyl group is optionally substituted by one or more substituents selected from aryl, OR7 and oxo; R7 represents, independently at each occurrence, H or C(O)R8; R8 represents C1..4 alkyl, aryl, C1.4 alkoxy and C1.4 alkylamino; R4 and 5 either independently represent H or C1-2 alkyl, or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached; and R6 represents H or C(O)-C131 alkyl.

13. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in any one of the preceding claims, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII is a __defined__ renin inhibitor, an ACE inhibitor or an AT1 receptor antagonist. 

14. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 13, wherein the inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII is a compound selected from the group consisting of aliskiren, ditekiren, enalkiren, remikiren, terlakiren, zankiren, benazepril, captopril, cilazapril, enalapril, fosinopril, lisinopril, moexepril, perindopril, quinapril, ramipril, trandolapril, candesartan, eprosartan, irbesartan, losartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, tasosartan, valsartan, ciclosidomine, furosemide and saralasin, wherein __candesartan__ is optionally in prodrug form __specifically identified as candesartan cilexetil__.
